Class InteractionMessageTransmitter

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.views.common.UDPTransmitter<InteractionMessageStrings>
sysmlinjava.views.interactionssequencediagram.InteractionMessageTransmitter
public class InteractionMessageTransmitter extends UDPTransmitter<InteractionMessageStrings>
The InteractionMessageTransmitter is a specialization of the UDPTransmitter to transmit InteractionMessageStrings to a InteractionMessageReceiver for the display of interaction messages. This class simply extends the generic UDPTransmitter for the InteractionMessageStrings.

      public InteractionMessageTransmitter(int udpPort, boolean logToConsole)
      Constructur with UDP port specification
      Parameters:
      udpPort - UDP port which to transmit interaction message data to
      logToConsole - whether to send all transmit() logs to console. Note: transmit() operation can log every object's toString() string to the console. The more frequently log messages are sent to console, the greater the CPU resources are needed. This can cause noticable slowing of the console display and related applications.
